name: storm-parity
description: PhpStorm-style workflow for VS Code: open-folder prompt, recent projects, mnemonic bookmarks, recent locations, clipboard history, surround with, scratch files, external libraries (include paths), changelists, shelf, local history and more.

scripts.build: bun run sync && bun run typecheck && node esbuild.mjs --production
scripts.pretest: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out',{recursive:true,force:true})" && bun run sync && bun run typecheck && node esbuild.mjs --tests

colors.description: Overview ruler mark for Storm bookmarks.

stormParity.keymap.enabled.description: Enable the PhpStorm-style keybindings contributed by Storm Parity. Commands stay available in the Command Palette when off.

stormParity.changelists.showStatusBar.description: Show the active changelist in the status bar.

stormParity.changelists.makeNewListActiv.description: Make a newly created changelist the active one.

stormParity.changelists.showCount.description: Show the number of changed files as a badge on the Changelists provider (off by default to avoid double counting with Git).

stormParity.clipboardHistory.enabled.description: Enable the Clipboard History feature (reload required).

stormParity.clipboardHistory.maxItems.description: Number of entries kept in the clipboard history.

stormParity.clipboardHistory.persist.description: Keep the clipboard history across VS Code restarts (stored in extension global state).

stormParity.composer.executable.markdownDescription: Composer command: a name on PATH, a path without spaces, or e.g. `php composer.phar`.

stormParity.externalLibraries.enabled.description: Enable the External Libraries feature (reload required).

stormParity.externalLibraries.includePat.markdownDescription: Folders outside the project shown under **External Libraries** and indexed for code intelligence (PhpStorm: *Settings > PHP > Include Path*). Absolute paths, `~/...`, or paths relative to the first workspace folder. While unset, `iextlibraries.includePaths` from the former iExternal Libraries extension is used.

stormParity.externalLibraries.intelephen.markdownDescription: Keep `#intelephense.environment.includePaths#` in sync with the external libraries so Intelephense indexes them. Entries you add to Intelephense yourself are kept. While unset, `iextlibraries.intelephense.sync` is used.

stormParity.localHistory.enabled.description: Enable the Local History feature (reload required).

stormParity.localHistory.retentionDays.description: Days to keep local history snapshots. Older snapshots are removed on startup and on save.

stormParity.localHistory.maxSnapshotsPer.description: Maximum number of snapshots kept per file (oldest are dropped first).

stormParity.localHistory.maxFileSizeKB.description: Files larger than this (in KB of text) are not snapshotted.

stormParity.localHistory.exclude.description: Glob patterns of files that never get local history snapshots.

stormParity.openFolder.enabled.description: Enable the Open Folder feature (reload required).

enumDescriptions: Ask every time (This Window / New Window / Attach).
Always open in the current window.
Always open in a new window.
stormParity.openFolder.defaultAction.description: What Storm Open Folder / Open Recent do with the chosen project. Also set by the "Remember my choice" toggle in the prompt.

stormParity.postfix.enabled.description: Enable the Postfix Completion (PHP) feature (reload required).

stormParity.projectColor.enabled.description: Enable the Project Color feature (reload required).

stormParity.projectColor.statusBar.description: Also tint the status bar with the project colour (the title bar is always tinted).

stormParity.recentLocations.enabled.description: Enable the Recent Locations feature (reload required).

stormParity.recentLocations.maxEntries.description: Maximum number of recent locations kept per workspace.

stormParity.recentLocations.mergeDistanc.description: A visit or edit within this many lines of an existing entry in the same file updates that entry instead of adding a new one.

stormParity.run.enabled.description: Enable the Run Widget feature (reload required).

stormParity.scratches.enabled.description: Enable the Scratch Files feature (reload required).

stormParity.selectIn.enabled.description: Enable the Select In feature (reload required).

stormParity.shelf.removeAfterUnshelve.description: Remove a shelf entry after it was unshelved without conflicts (default choice in Unshelve, always used by Unshelve Silently).

stormParity.surroundWith.enabled.description: Enable the Surround With feature (reload required).

stormParity.terminal.tabsBelow.markdownDescription: Run terminals as tabs in a full-width editor group below the code (PhpStorm-style tab strip). Turn on or off with **Storm: Toggle Terminal Tabs Below**, which also moves open terminals. Opt+F12 then shows, focuses and hides that group.

stormParity.todo.patterns.description: Case-sensitive words recognised as TODO items when they appear after a comment opener (//, #, /*, *, <!--, --, ;).

stormParity.todo.regex.description: Custom JavaScript regular expression applied per line, overriding `patterns`. Capture group 1 (if present) is used as the pattern name.

stormParity.todo.exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from the TODO scan, in addition to files.exclude and search.exclude.

stormParity.todo.maxFileSizeKB.description: Files larger than this (in KB) are skipped.
